# Macros: Callout, ConfirmBar, InfoRow, StatTile (shortcuts made of basic components)

• Callout(title, body, tone? (static))
  - Description: A highlighted note with an icon: a tip, a confirmation, a warning or an error.
  - title: A few words, e.g. "Heads up".
  - body: One or two sentences.
  - tone: Which icon it carries: info, success, warning or error. Must be one of: 'info', 'success', 'warning', 'error'

• ConfirmBar(question, on_confirm (static), on_cancel (static), confirm_label? (static), cancel_label? (static))
  - Description: Asks the user to confirm before you create, change, send or delete something.
  - question: What is about to happen, e.g. "Delete the 3 draft emails?".
  - on_confirm: The Event sent when they confirm.
  - on_cancel: The Event sent when they cancel.
  - confirm_label: Text of the confirm button.
  - cancel_label: Text of the cancel button.

• InfoRow(label, value)
  - Description: One line of a details list: the label at the left, its value at the right.
  - label: The field name, e.g. "Check-in".
  - value: Its value, e.g. "14 March".

• StatTile(label, value, note?)
  - Description: A KPI: a small label, its value under it, and an optional note.
  - label: What is measured, e.g. "Monthly saving".
  - value: The number or short text, e.g. "₹12,400".
  - note: Optional caption under the value, e.g. "up 8% on last month".

These are shortcuts made of basic components: use them instead of building the same Column or Row by hand. They can sit anywhere a basic component can (inside a Card, Column, Row, List).
Example:
  root = Card(Column([stats, when, tip, ask]))
  stats = Row([StatTile("Saved", "₹12,400", "up 8%"), StatTile("Goal", "₹50,000")])
  when = InfoRow("Check-in", "14 March")
  tip = Callout("Heads up", "Prices change daily.", "warning")
  ask = ConfirmBar("Send these 3 emails?", Event("confirm_send"), Event("cancel_send"), "Send")
